name: DCSync_UpdateWhitelist
author: CySOC
description: Add the user+host pair(s) of a DCSync case to the whitelist stored in Consul KV. Stable identifiers (Microsoft Defender device id, directory object id) are read from the MicrosoftDefender enrichment analyzer reports attached to the observables, so different spellings of the same user/host never create duplicate entries. Fails when an observable lacks enrichment. Run by the analyst when a true positive is rejected at the final verification step.

configurationItems.name: thehive_api_key
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key with permission to read observables

configurationItems.name: consul_kv_prefix
configurationItems.description: Consul KV prefix holding the whitelist entries
